Description: {{TAG|VDW_RADIUS}} (in Å) sets the two-body interaction cutoff in van der Waals methods.
----

{{TAG|VDW_RADIUS}} (in Å) allows to set the two-body interaction cutoff for the [[DFT-D2]], DFT-D3 ([[DFT-D3]] and [[simple-DFT-D3]] implementations), [[DFT-D4]], [[DFT-ulg]], [[DDsC_dispersion_correction|DDsC]], and Tkatchenko-Scheffler methods.
{{NB|mind|Available for the [[DFT-D4]] and [[simple-DFT-D3]] packages since VASP.6.6.0.}}
